statements.status_notes: DHI backport of upstream gh-150751 (python/cpython commits 2eb2af805c156ca52b316bb4ced5e0ab3971d0ae and 9f52b443c002cccfb54bda0706a9276b6b4a109d) applied to 3.10.22 through 3.15.2. http.client validates the Content-Length header as decimal digits only (RFC 9112 1*DIGIT), ignoring optional spaces or tabs around the value; a value with a sign, an underscore, or an embedded space is not used as the body length. Chunk sizes are validated as hexadecimal digits (RFC 9112 1*HEXDIG, 0-9, a-f and A-F), so valid upper- and lower-case hex chunk sizes are accepted, while a sign, a 0x prefix, an underscore or leading whitespace is rejected instead of being parsed with int(value, 16).

DHI backport of upstream gh-150751 (python/cpython commits 2eb2af805c156ca52b316bb4ced5e0ab3971d0ae and 9f52b443c002cccfb54bda0706a9276b6b4a109d) applied to 3.10.22 through 3.15.2. http.client validates the Content-Length header as decimal digits only (RFC 9112 1*DIGIT), ignoring optional spaces or tabs around the value; a value with a sign, an underscore, or an embedded space is not used as the body length. Chunk sizes are validated as hexadecimal digits (RFC 9112 1*HEXDIG, 0-9, a-f and A-F), so valid upper- and lower-case hex chunk sizes are accepted, while a sign, a 0x prefix, an underscore or leading whitespace is rejected instead of being parsed with int(value, 16).
DHI backport of https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/160899 (commit 131a3a66c5f400b588f9fd2732a5ed4e89623ee3) rejects null bytes in socket.getaddrinfo() host and port parameters.

The tarfile extraction-filter issue is mitigated in listed artifacts: earlier DHI CPython rebuilds include a maintainer backport of https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/156000, and current Debian 13 leaves build upstream CPython micro-releases that already contain the same fix per https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-19672.

Python 3.14.6 includes the upstream remote debugging / asyncio introspection bounds-check fix from https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/148187, so the vulnerable code is not present in the shipped DHI package.

Python 3.13.14 and 3.14.6 already include the upstream bz2 decompressor fix in the packaged source tarball, so the vulnerable code is not present in the shipped DHI package. See https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/150599
